title: British gravity research memo stamped Wright-Patterson with missing pages

tellings.quote: the copy I saw was stamped right Patterson Air Force Base on it and it missed about like five pages like there's this big legend about the missing five pages about where it's like it was achieved in the mid-century in and then it cuts off

plain: The story is that there is a memo about British research into controlling gravity, and that the copy a researcher named Greg Bishop saw was stamped with the name of Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, an Air Force base in Ohio, and was missing about five pages. Bishop tells it from what he saw himself, and says a legend grew around those pages: the text reaches a point saying something was achieved in the mid-twentieth century, and then cuts off. If true, it would hint that a gravity breakthrough was recorded and then pulled out of the file.
